works.title: On Wealth and Poverty
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series
works.author: John Chrysostom
works.blurb: Chrysostom's sermons on Lazarus and the rich man, uncompromising, pastoral, and pointed. A modern English translation that reads aloud as well as it preaches.

works.title: On Marriage and Family Life
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series
works.author: John Chrysostom
works.blurb: A practical patristic vision for husbands, wives, and children, the household as the little Church. Drawn from the homilies on Ephesians and Colossians.

works.title: Discourses Against Judaizing Christians
works.subtitle: The Fathers of the Church, volume 68, translated by Paul W. Harkins
works.author: John Chrysostom
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: Eight sermons preached in Antioch in 386 and 387 to Christians who were keeping the Jewish feasts and fasts. Their words about the Jewish people are harsh, and were later used to justify hatred of Jews. Listed here for study.
